sections.title: 1. The service
sections.body: ShashGuru provides chess engine analysis and AI-generated commentary. The engine part is free. The AI commentary is available with prepaid credits, a subscription, or your own API key.

sections.title: 2. Accounts
sections.body: You need an account to use the AI commentary. You are responsible for keeping your login secure and for the activity on your account.

sections.title: 3. Credits and payments
sections.body: Credits are consumed according to the tokens used by each request and the model chosen. Subscription credits expire at the end of each billing period; purchased credits do not expire. Payments are processed by a third-party payment provider; we do not store your card details.

sections.title: 4. Your own API keys
sections.body: If you add your own provider key, usage is billed by that provider to you. We store the key encrypted and use it only to run your requests. You can delete it at any time.

sections.title: 5. Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not abuse the service, attempt to bypass limits, or use it to send unlawful content. We may rate-limit or suspend accounts that do.

sections.title: 6. AI content
sections.body: AI-generated commentary may contain errors. It is provided for information and study purposes only.

sections.title: 7. Refunds
sections.body: Unused purchased credits may be refunded on request within the period required by applicable consumer law. Contact us to ask.

sections.title: 8. Liability
sections.body: The service is provided as is, without warranty, to the extent permitted by law. The ShashGuru source code is free software under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms: [contact email to be added].

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: The controller of your data is [legal name and address to be added].

sections.title: 2. Data we process
sections.body: Account data (email, identifier), the positions and questions you send for analysis, usage records (model, tokens, credits), and your encrypted API keys if you add any.

sections.title: 3. Why
sections.body: To provide the service, apply credits and limits, prevent abuse and comply with legal obligations (e.g. invoicing).

sections.title: 4. Processors
sections.body: We use third parties to run the service: an authentication provider, a payment provider and the AI model providers that answer your requests (the positions and questions you send are transmitted to them). When you use your own key, your requests go to the provider you chose.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
sections.body: We only use technical cookies and local storage needed for login, payments and your preferences. No advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.title: 6. Retention
sections.body: Account and usage data are kept while your account exists; invoices are kept as long as the law requires. Analysis contexts expire automatically after a short time.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You can export your data and delete your account from the Account page. You can also contact us to exercise your access, rectification, erasure, portability and objection rights, or complain to your data protection authority.
